def dih(p0,p1,p2,p3):
    b0 = p0-p1; b1 = p2-p1; b2 = p3-p2
    b1n = b1/np.linalg.norm(b1)

for b in m.GetBonds():

    bonded[i,j]=bonded[j,i]=True
np.fill_diagonal(bonded, True)
# 1-3 pairs also excluded from clash check

adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]
for b in m.GetBonds():
    i,j = b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    adj[i].add(j); adj[j].add(i)
excl = bonded.copy()
for i in range(n):

            excl[i,k]=True
D = np.linalg.norm(P[:,None,:]-P[None,:,:], axis=-1)
Dm = np.ma.masked_array(D, excl)
i,j = np.unravel_index(np.argmin(Dm), Dm.shape)
print('min nonbonded(1-4+) distance', round(float(Dm.min()),2), S[i], i, S[j], j)
# check all bonded distances reasonable
bad=[]
for b in m.GetBonds():
    i,j = b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    d = np.linalg.norm(P[i]-P[j])
    if d > 2.7 or d < 0.9:
        bad.append((i,S[i],j,S[j],round(d,2)))
print('odd bond lengths:', bad)
print('formula check: elements', {e:S.count(e) for e in set(S)})
